Esra Öztoprak is a quality consultant and the representative for the data controller authority within the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD) [^src1]. In this capacity, she plays a central role in ensuring compliance with data protection legislation and maintaining data integrity within the national registry [^src1]. 

Her involvement is documented in the 2023 annual report for DANIBD, which outlines the composition of the registry's steering group and provides detailed quality data for the period spanning October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023 [^src1]. As part of this strategic steering unit, her work supports the broader national effort to systematize and improve the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in Denmark through cross-regional quality measurement, standardized coding, and the evidence-based development of treatment guidelines [^src1].
